requirement: An agent turn survives a seat without an address and a tracy-web restart, a plan's fallback keeps the system prompt, comment write: lines and webroot reads stay inside the site, and the fleet model row keeps toolUpdate and the default retry codes

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'a seat without a proven address runs on the deployment default and never asks the broker' passes. 'tracy-web restarting keeps a conversation without a plan on the default, and nothing else' passes. 'the Tracy AI note keeps the whole system prompt' passes. 'a person's words can never become a write: line' and 'a write: line naming a bare file allows that webroot file' pass. 'an uploads folder linked into another site lists none of that site's pictures', 'a planted symlink area never brings another site's file into tracy_find_definition' and 'a planted symlink never lists another site's extensions' pass. 'the fleet model row losing the catalogue row's toolUpdate is red' and 'a fleet retryable-code list without one of dsh's defaults is red' pass.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
